title: Accelerated High-Accuracy Sampling from a Warm Start via the Proximal Bouncy Particle Sampler
summary: We study the problem of sampling from $μ(\mathrm{d}x)\propto e^{-V(x)}\,\mathrm{d}x$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, where $V$ is $α$-strongly convex and $β$-smooth, and write $κ:=β/α$. We design and analyze the Proximal Bouncy Particle Sampler (Proximal BPS), a new sampler that combines ideas from the proximal sampler and the bouncy particle sampler. From a warm start initialization with $ O(1) $ Rényi divergence w.r.t. $μ$, Proximal BPS returns a sample whose law is $\varepsilon$-close to $μ$ in total variation distance using $\widetilde O(\sqrtκ\,d^{1/4} \,\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon))$ gradient…
